The slow marker is registered and addopts deselects it; soak test is marked slow; make test is the fast path and make test-soak selects slow

Every compose service is read-only with tmpfs /tmp, cap_drop ALL and no-new-privileges; topology unchanged; compose config validates
lint, typecheck and audit are path-conditional on services/desk-signer/src; no-ops today, as the plan requires
Ownership manifest validates and every files_modified path resolves to bot-02-risk
